people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

people.name: Haman
people.line: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

translations.web: Esther said, “An adversary and an enemy, even this wicked Haman!” Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.
translations.bsb: Esther replied, “The adversary and enemy is this wicked man—Haman!” And Haman stood in terror before the king and queen.
translations.kjv: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.
